headline: Government keeps essential fuels frozen; others fall
summary: The Dominican government said essential fuel prices will remain unchanged for the week of November 21-27, under a freeze in place until January 7, 2027.
why: Regulated fuel prices in the Dominican Republic affect transport costs, inflation and household budgets, and the government subsidises the freeze.
original_headline: Gobierno mantiene congelado combustibles esenciales; otros bajan
